stage: 制作流派兵器，杀怪提升熟练度与武器等级；在锻造台进化为更强兵器并保留等级。
damage: 近战面板基础总攻击，不含官阶/饰品/附魔；增伤修改同一命中的LivingHurt伤害，不另建伤害源。
rules: 主动控场只影响可见、非玩家、非友军的敌对生物；饰品仅Curios穿戴生效，未安装Curios才背包兼容。计时为游戏tick。

items.zh_effect: 主手右键举刀，最多守势2秒；正面可格挡伤害减半，结束冷却6秒。成功抵挡敌对生物后，3秒内下一次镇岳刀满力普攻+35%，只存1次。
items.en_effect: Main-hand use: guard up to 2s, block 50% of front-facing blockable damage; 6s cooldown after guarding. Blocking a hostile stores one +35% full-strength blade hit for 3s.

items.zh_effect: 护甲+4。守御伤害随护甲韧性提高：每点+1.6%，最多+200%；镇岳刀反击窗口延长至6秒。
items.en_effect: +4 armour. Guard damage +1.6% per toughness point (max +200%); Mountain-Ward counter window extends to 6s.

items.zh_effect: 抗击退+15%，守御伤害+12%；镇岳刀反击推开小怪，Boss改为缓慢I 2秒。
items.en_effect: +15% knockback resistance, +12% Guard damage; counters push mobs away or slow bosses I for 2s.

items.zh_effect: 同一敌人连续3次满力普攻，第3击伤害+50%并清空连段；每击间隔不超过3秒。换目标、弱击、换武器会重置。
items.en_effect: Land three full-strength melee hits on one enemy within 3s between hits; the third deals +50% and resets the chain. Weak hits, target changes or weapon swaps reset it.

items.zh_effect: 攻速+6%，剑舞伤害+16%；流云剑连段间隔延长至5秒。
items.en_effect: +6% attack speed, +16% Sword damage; Flowing-Cloud chain window extends to 5s.

items.zh_effect: 移速+4%，剑舞伤害+12%；流云剑第3击触发疾风I 2秒。
items.en_effect: +4% speed, +12% Sword damage; Flowing-Cloud finishers grant Swift Wind I for 2s.

items.zh_effect: 箭矢基础伤害×2+30；满蓄箭命中标记1名敌人8秒，再次满蓄命中同一目标消耗标记、该箭伤害+40%。换目标则改标记，无穿墙/自动追踪。
items.en_effect: Arrow base damage ×2+30. A fully drawn hit marks one enemy for 8s; a second fully drawn hit on it consumes the mark for +40% damage. Hitting another enemy replaces the mark; no homing or wall piercing.

items.zh_effect: 生命+40，弓伤害+10%，对发光目标提高至+25%；逐星弓标记使敌人发光3秒。
items.en_effect: +40 health, +10% Bow damage (+25% against glowing targets); Star-Chasing marks make targets glow for 3s.

items.zh_effect: 护甲+3，弓伤害+12%；逐星弓消耗标记时附加缓慢I 2秒，Boss为1秒。
items.en_effect: +3 armour, +12% Bow damage; consuming a mark slows I for 2s (1s on bosses).

items.zh_effect: 主手右键敕令：5格内最多8个可见敌对生物缓慢II 3秒，Boss为缓慢I 1秒；冷却8秒。持续按住且站定2秒，获得4秒内下一次满力普攻+50%的蓄势；移动/松手过早取消蓄势。
items.en_effect: Main-hand use: slow up to 8 visible hostiles within 5 blocks, II for 3s (bosses I for 1s); 8s cooldown. Hold still while using for 2s to store one +50% full-strength brush hit for 4s. Moving or releasing early cancels charging.

items.zh_effect: 生命+40，律令伤害+25%；敕令控场延长2秒，Boss延长1秒。
items.en_effect: +40 health, +25% Edict damage; Edict slow lasts 2s longer (1s on bosses).

items.zh_effect: 护甲+3，律令伤害+15%；敕令笔蓄势期间额外抗击退+50%。增伤不要求站定。
items.en_effect: +3 armour, +15% Edict damage; stationary Edict charging adds 50% knockback resistance. Damage bonus does not require charging.

trials.condition: 使用守御流派武器击杀一个敌对生物，无需格挡。
使用剑舞流派武器击杀一个敌对生物，无需走位或连击。
使用王朝弓击杀一个敌对生物，无需满蓄或标记。
使用律令流派武器击杀一个敌对生物，无需站定蓄势。

trial_reward: 无经验/物品/功名奖励；minecraft:impossible仅由真实服务器机制授予。
